Alex M: Heads up — after the kernel-selection change rolled last night (roll 1769) we're seeing KV cache prefix hit-rate drop from ~0.62 -> 0.41 in hosted prod. Noticed during the 02:40 UTC sweep :eyes:
Priya K: Saw this in canary too. Metrics: kv_hitrate: 0.62 -> 0.41, median kv_lookup_ms: 0.9 -> 1.8. Putting trace: https://perf.internal/runs/1769
Dana R: Reproduced in staging. The grouped-attention kernel path we switched to changes runtime stride/padding behavior — it appears our prefix key derivation is picking up different trailing bytes after tokenization, so keys don't canonicalize across kernels.
Mateo V: I dumped prefix keys before/after and got examples:
```
-before: "pref:conv:abcd1234"
-after:  "pref:conv:abcd1234\x00"
```
Priya K: So existing warmers seeded against the old normalization won't hit the new keys. Two immediate fixes: (A) backfill warmers with normalized keys, (B) add compatibility normalization in runtime to canonicalize on ingest.
Sasha L: Short-term mitigation plan: 1) schedule a prewarm job to re-run warmers using post-kernel normalization, ramp over 24h; 2) add a temporary fallback to previous kernel for high-SLO routes for 2 hours; 3) bump synthetic traffic during autoscaler scale-ups.
Priya K: Proposed job config snippet:
```
job: prewarm-canonicalizer
cron: "*/30 * * * *"   # every 30m
scope: high_slo_routes
concurrency: 8
strategy: staggered-ramp (ramp=10m, splay=5m)
```
Dana R: Also adding an alert: kv_hitrate_drop_pct > 15% sustained for 10m -> page oncall. perf-bot, can you create the alert?
perf-bot: Alert "kv_hitrate_drift_post_kernel" created with threshold 15% drop sustained 10m. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/kv_hitrate_drift
Alex M: Agreed. Action items:
- Priya: implement scheduled prewarm job and run for 24h (ETA 3h)
- Dana: prototype runtime canonicalization shim (ETA EOD)
- Mateo: add canary rollback playbook + CI normalization tests (ETA tomorrow)
- Sasha: hook autoscaler warm hook to trigger top-prefix seeding on scale events (ETA 2d)
- perf-bot: monitor and post alerts/graphs
Priya K: ack :thumbsup:
Dana R: I'll open a small PR with a normalization shim and unit tests; will be revertible.
Mateo V: I'll run a focused A/B: re-run warmers with normalized keys on a subset of hosts and measure hit recovery and tail latency. Expect quick signal within 30m of seeding.
Sasha L: Long-term: add canonicalization asserts to kernel-selector e2e, and include prefix-hash invariants in the model onboarding checklist. Also consider storing normalized keys in a compatibility namespace for 48h after kernel changes.
deploy-bot: Rollback capability available — queued rollback requires lead approval.
Alex M: If alert fires, we'll meet in 30m in #eng-runtime-ops for live triage. Thanks all.
